biocontainers.name: bioconductor-synmut
biocontainers.summary: SynMut: Designing Synonymously Mutated Sequences with Different Genomic Signatures

biotools.summary: There are increasing demands on designing virus mutants with specific dinucleotide or codon composition. This tool can take both dinucleotide preference and/or codon usage bias into account while designing mutants. It is a powerful tool for in silico designs of DNA sequence mutants.
